diagnostics.message: google_compute_project_default_network_tier.default_network_tier configures the Compute Engine default network tier, so the Compute API must be enabled first. It has no dependency on google_project_service.project_services (unlike the sibling google_compute_project_metadata_item.default).

google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service attaches this project as a Shared VPC service project, which requires the Compute API in the service project. It only depends on the VPC-SC perimeter resources, not on google_project_service.project_services.

google_project_iam_member.service_agents explicitly depends on google_project_service.project_services, but it already depends on google_project_service_identity.default, which itself depends on google_project_service.project_services.

google_logging_project_sink.sink explicitly depends on google_project_service.project_services, but the project IAM binding/member resources it already depends on also depend on google_project_service.project_services.

google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_agent_cmek explicitly depends on google_project_service.project_services, but it already depends on google_project_service_identity.default and google_project_iam_member.service_agents, both of which depend on google_project_service.project_services.

google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_agent_cmek explicitly depends on google_project_service_identity.default, but it already depends on google_project_iam_member.service_agents, which depends on google_project_service_identity.default.

google_project_iam_member.shared_vpc_host_robots explicitly depends on google_project_service.project_services, but its dependencies on google_project_service_identity.default, google_project_default_service_accounts.default_service_accounts, and the two service-account data sources all already depend on google_project_service.project_services.

google_compute_subnetwork_iam_member.shared_vpc_host_robots explicitly depends on google_project_service.project_services, but its dependencies on google_project_service_identity.default, google_project_default_service_accounts.default_service_accounts, and the two service-account data sources all already depend on google_project_service.project_services.
